_about: Replay overrides for two runs of the FOMC question on two backends (`e2er run-matrix`, end-to-end story E2E-20). Both runs replay the FOMC recording; each run's estimation adds the headline 'main' entry `e2er compare` reads. On claude_code it is the regression on the declared treatment term (dgs2_change_day0) with its standard error; on codex it is three means (all, hikes, cuts) without the treatment term or a standard error, and the design names another outcome, the way the two live runs of 2026-10-05 differed.
